rss.title: parse_number() as a SQLite extension: C vs Rust
rss.summary: Research: parse_number() as a SQLite extension: C vs Rust I was out walking the dog when I got curious about how easy/difficult it would be to write a SQLite C extension that adds a parse_number() function for turning strings like -$1,234.56 or '12.5%' into numeric values that could be summed and sorted. I fired up regular Claude chat (Opus 5.5) and prompted : I'm thinking about a SQLite custom function 'parse_number(value)' that strips ',', '$', '£' and '%', handles a leading '-', and returns 'NULL' for anything it can’t parse Explore the difference between building this as a SQLite extension in C v.s. in Rust - I want to compare performance and code complexity and size of the resulting .so (or whatever) file This gave me a solid starting point - the Rust extension was 321 KB (using Rusqlite ) and 298 KB (using sqlite-loadable-rs ), while the C extension was 14 KB. But the Rust extension was faster! Turns out that's because the Rust equivalent of C's strtod is "twice as fast". So I prompted: Try writing your own C function for parsing text into a decimal number that catches up to or beats the Rust implementation And it did: Net cost per row over 2 million rows, lower is better: first C new C rusqlite sqlite-loadable Mixed data 67 ns 19 ns 46 ns 41 ns Integers only 25 ns 16 ns 36 ns 32 ns Decimals only 106 ns 18 ns 55 ns 47 ns Finally, I had it rewrite the prototype as a research report to match the others in simonw/research by prompting this: Clone simonw/research from GitHub and turn your above investigation into a research report as seen in that repository - you can give me a zip file to download that contains your new folder Here's the resulting report . rss.title: datasette #3046: Don't serve link: rel=next HTTP headers to Firefox for HTML pages
rss.summary: datasette #3046: Don't serve link: rel=next HTTP headers to Firefox for HTML pages I was looking at the Firefox network panel today when I noticed that requests to a Datasette table page were triggering an HTTP prefetch to the next page of rows in that table. This was happening because Datasette pages serve an HTTP link header like this: link: <https://latest.datasette.io/fixtures/compound_three_primary_keys?_next=a%2Cd%2Cv>; rel="next" This is bad. A tiny fraction of the visitors to one of those pages will click the "next" link, which means their browser is fetching unnecessary data and the Datasette server is having to render an entire page that then gets thrown away. I dug in and learned that Firefox has an issue that has been open for 24 years about this behavior... And one of the early comments on that issue links to my blog post from 2002 complaining about this feature. I hadn't just forgotten that I had written about it, I had forgotten the feature entirely! rss.summary: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.
rss.text_excerpt: Today we’re announcing a partnership with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems. Our engineers and Hacktron’s security researchers will choose high-priority areas to test together, with a focus on how our systems interact with third-party services. As part of the partnership, we’re expanding Hacktron’s access to our frontier models through Daybreak Red . As we work to accelerate cyber defense with frontier AI, we’re applying the same urgency to finding and fixing vulnerabilities in our own systems. Earlier this week, we announced that Cathedral’s researchers will work alongside our teams in our next security sprint . We also raised our bug bounty rewards to give independent researchers more reason to pursue vulnerabilities our own testing may have missed. We became familiar with Hacktron through our Security Bug Bounty program and were impressed by the impact of the vulnerabilities its researchers have discovered and disclosed to us. The team builds AI agents for code review, penetration testing, and red teaming. Their research ⁠ (opens in a new window) has uncovered vulnerabilities in how applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems interact. Their work shows what’s possible when security engineers build around AI to move faster and take on more ambitious research. As AI agents connect services in new ways, that combination of skills becomes even more valuable. Working alongside Hacktron will help us test those connections more deeply and use what we learn to strengthen our defenses. We’re grateful to Hacktron and other independent researchers who put time into finding and reporting weaknesses to help strengthen the security that protects all our users. To see which systems are in scope or submit a finding, visit our Security Bug Bounty program ⁠ (opens in a new window) .

--- ## 简介 HyperParallel 面向昇腾超节点提供分布式并行加速能力。针对资源池化、对等架构、分层网络拓扑和 FP8 低精度格式等特点，框架覆盖从集群分布式并行到芯片内多核并行，并支持 CPU DRAM 与 NPU HBM 池化管理、拓扑感知调度、通信路径规划和 FP8 混合精度训练。 --- ## 核心设计 - **模型与系统优化解耦**：HyperParallel 将并行、重计算和 Offload 等系统优化从模型代码中分离，并通过声明式接口注入模型；并行范式覆盖集群 SPMD、集群 MPMD 和芯片内多核 MPMD，面向大语言模型和多模态模型训练。 - **兼容 Hugging Face 生态**：HyperParallel 支持直接读取 Hugging Face 模型配置和预训练权重，并复用 Transformers 中已有的模型实现；模型创建后，由 HyperParallel 以声明式方式将并行、重计算和算子替换等分布式逻辑注入模型。 - **全流程确定性**：HyperParallel 支持计算、通信、数据预处理和随机数等环节的确定性，并对已支持模型进行 bitwise 对齐验证。确定性模式可能带来性能开销，但有助于复现训练结果、发现 SDC 和定位问题。 - **动静混合**：静态图有利于通算并发、内存分析和执行序编排，但完整动转静对模型语法和编译能力要求较高。HyperParallel 在动态图基础上支持受约束的局部动转静。 --- ## 📣 最新消息 - [Aug. 25, 2026]: [Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B 模型支持](hyper_parallel/models/qwen3_moe/recipes/train.yaml) --- ## 使用入口 ### HyperParallel 模型训练 > [HyperParallel 模型](hyper_parallel/models/README.md) 面向训练用户，通过 YAML 配置 Hugging Face 模型、数据、优化器、并行策略以及保存与恢复方式。 > > **支持模型** > > - [Qwen3-30B-A3B](hyper_parallel/models/qwen3_moe/recipes/train.yaml) ### HyperParallel Core > [HyperParallel Core](docs/api/api_reference.md) 面向模型作者和框架开发者，提供从分布式模型构建到训练执行与状态管理的底层能力。 > > **核心能力** > > - **模型切分与并行组合**：以 DeviceMesh、DTensor 和 Shard 描述设备拓扑与 Tensor 布局，并组合 FSDP/HSDP、TP、CP、EP、PP 等并行策略。 > - **MoE 与异构执行**：覆盖专家切分、路由和 token dispatch，以及流水线调度、集群 MPMD 和芯片内多核 MPMD。 > - **内存与性能优化**：提供 Activation Checkpoint、Activation Swap、通信与计算重叠、通信融合和自动并行能力。 > - **训练与状态管理**：提供优化器、分布式检查点、异步保存、离线格式转换和确定性训练能力。 > >

## 这不是一个知识仓库 知识正在变得无限、即时，并且越来越便宜。再多整理一份概念、转述一次共识，价值都很有限。 真正稀缺的，是知识经过一个具体的人、一段真实经历和一次实际工作之后，留下的东西：做过什么，为什么这样做，哪里失败过，判断因此发生了怎样的变化。 > AI 可以重写一段文字，却无法替我经历一次失败、做出一个选择，或为一个长期判断付出代价。 > > 这个仓库存下的，正是这些不可代写的部分。 [cubxxw.com](https://cubxxw.com/zh/) 是我的公开写作现场。这里没有“每天学一个新概念”的任务，也不追逐看起来正确的答案。文章只沉淀三类东西：亲自验证过的实践、可以复用的工作流，以及经得起回看的思考。 ## 三条持续写下去的线 **01 / 把 AI 变成一套真正能工作的系统** 不止讨论模型和提示词，而是研究 Agent、上下文、记忆、评测、安全边界与自动化，怎样进入真实生产流程。这里保留架构选择，也保留失败现场。 **02 / 把信息变成一个人的能力** 信息不是知识，收藏也不是拥有。我持续拆解自己的知识管理、第二大脑、内容创作与个人工作流，关心的是它们如何穿过“信息—记录—知识—创作”，最后抵达行动。 **03 / 在机器越来越强的时候，继续成为一个具体的人** 技术之外，我写选择、关系、身份、风险、城市与远行。不是为了给人生总结规律，而是留下足够诚实的现场证据：我在哪里，我经历了什么，我如何被它改变。 技术文章会尽量给出可复现的路径，思考文章会交代推理过程，个人文章会保留现场。它们共同回答同一个问题： > 当越来越多的能力可以外包给 AI，什么仍然必须由自己完成？ ## 从这里开始 如果你第一次来到这里，这几篇文章最接近这个仓库的内核： - [一个人带一队 Agent，把 120 多篇文章的博客重新组装了一遍](https://cubxxw.com/zh/ai-agent/posts/ai-native-blog-rebuild/) — 一次真实的大规模 Agent 协作现场，而不是自动化想象。 - [AI 知识工作流：从信息、记录、知识到创作](https://cubxxw.com/zh/ai-agent/posts/info-to-creation-the-framework/) — 我如何划分个人知识系统里四种完全不同的东西。 - [AI 工作流质量门禁：把软件工程的纪律搬进个人系统](https://cubxxw.com/zh/ai-agent/posts/engineering-discipline-ai-workflow/) — 让 AI 产出从“看起来不错”走向可验证、可恢复、可持续。 - [Agent Engineering 全景地图：98.4% 只是 Harness [TRUNCATED]

vococo

基于 Claude 订阅 的个人 AI 助理，单用户、常驻、语音优先、多渠道共用一个大脑。

--- ## 截图 | 聊天 · 工具调用 | 工作台 | |:---:|:---:| | ![chat](docs/images/chat.jpg) | ![workbench](docs/images/workbench.jpg) | | **语音对话** | **定时任务** | | ![voice](docs/images/voice.jpg) | ![cron](docs/images/cron.jpg) | --- > 完整需求与验收标准见 [REQUIREMENTS.md](REQUIREMENTS.md)。 ## 特性 - **多渠道，一个会话** — TUI / CLI / Web（自建 PWA，手机浏览器直达）；全端共享同一主会话 - **Web 自建 UI** — 多会话侧边栏、工具调用卡片、模型面板 + 限额环、设置页全在线改 - **语音优先** — 按住说话（STT）、TTS 朗读、Omni 实时免提通话（可打断） - **统一会话** — 新会话统一 `session:`；定时、进度、通知为附加能力，任务与规则 ID 独立关联；旧会话继续兼容 - **共用执行流程** — 普通聊天与后台任务共用上下文、压缩、事件记录；`continue_session` 支持空闲任务会话，忙碌时拒绝跨会话打断；代码任务仍隔离运行 - **Agent 分层委托** — 持久 Agent 间创建普通独立会话，可继续追问；自动派单两层/五任务与可靠回执，不等于同步子代理 - **长期记忆** — 启动注入 `~/AI_BRAIN`；`save_memory` 沉淀、`recall_past` 召回，纯 Markdown - **记忆库体检** — 原 `REFLECT_*` 调度只审计 `MEMORY.md` 与 `memory/**/*.md`，不读聊天、不改记忆；结构全查、正文轮巡，具体边界见 [OPERATIONS.md](OPERATIONS.md#共享记忆库体检)。 - **多供应商热切换** — DeepSeek / Kimi / 任意 Anthropic 兼容中转，设置页添加即生效 - **运行数据面板** — 设置页「数据」:工作强度日历、各模型用量与花费、缓存命中/工具成功率，逐个会话可下钻 - **安全模型 + 自我运维** — 危险三档闸、手机审批；`vococo doctor` 自检、`restart_self` 安全重启、看门狗防假死 ## Agent 工作目录与权限 Agent 的 `workdir` 保留项目身份及规则来源；`execution_mode=workspace` 时，从仓库外 `~/vococo-workspaces//` 运行，正式成果写 `output_dir`（默认原 workdir，可为 iCloud）。 iCloud/非 Git 目录默认 workspace，开发 Git 项目默认 project；总助理不变。 所有 Agent 都支持写代码和设置 AI/脚本定时任务，不再按业务/开发身份强制启用文件或网络沙箱。 工作区、成果目录及可写关联沿用直接写入豁免；其他目录使用常规审批，不再直接拒绝。 推送、发布等危险操作保留审批，直接修改 Agent 权限配置仍拦截；iCloud 失败明确报错，不自动改存源码目录。 注意：审批钩子不是系统级隔离，Bash 子进程不具备强制文件边界；仅运行可信任务与脚本。 业务 Agent 可在「设置 → 代码仓库」绑定多个 Git 根目录（`repositories`）。每会话自动在 `~/vococo-workspaces/.repositories//<会话哈希>/<仓库哈希>/` 建独立克隆与分支， 不共享 Git 元数据；默认使用副本避免相互覆盖。修改、构建和本地提交优先使用提示词提供的副本路径，推送/发布保留原有审批。 副本不含未提交修改、忽略的 `.env` 或依赖，不自动拉取远端；取消绑定从下一轮生效， 不强行中断当前命令、不删除已有副本。初始化可用 `scripts/bind_business_repositories.py --data-dir /实际/data目录 --bind AGENT_ID=/仓库根目录`，默认预览，`--apply` 备份配置并准备主会话副本。 业务会话仍不能自行注册/切换 MCP；AI 和脚本 cron 均可通过内置工具管理，创建仍需主人当场批准，后台不能自行创建。固定脚本保持原目录。 迁移先预览，带 `--apply` 才更新并备份；不会移动历史 [TRUNCATED]

# Coding2API [![CI](https://github.com/RobbsLuo/Coding2API/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/RobbsLuo/Coding2API/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/RobbsLuo/Coding2API)](https://github.com/RobbsLuo/Coding2API/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/github/license/RobbsLuo/Coding2API)](LICENSE) [![Image](https://img.shields.io/badge/image-ghcr.io%2Frobbsluo%2Fcoding2api-blue)](https://github.com/RobbsLuo/Coding2API/pkgs/container/coding2api) 十路渠道——**CodeBuddy**（国内 + 国际，两个独立渠道）、**TRAE SOLO**、**OpenCode Zen**、**Kilo**、**Qoder**、**CodeArts**、**OfficeAce**、**小浣熊**、**灵犀**——封装成 OpenAI 兼容 API：公共凭证池、统一模型名与调度、按人用量统计。 > [!WARNING] > 逆向接口，仅供学习研究，未做安全审计；公网部署需反向代理 + 鉴权 + IP 白名单。 ## 特性 - **OpenAI 兼容出口**：`/v1/chat/completions`（流式 / 非流式）、`/v1/responses`（Codex CLI）、`/v1/messages`（Claude Code）、`/v1/models`（含单模型查询）、`/v1/user/balance`。 - **统一调度**：扁平名按健康度选号；`模型@渠道` 强制。优先级：免费渠道 → 在途最少 → 到期额度 → 健康度 + 分级冷却 → 余额多者。目录里的 x0 会被最近 24h 的实测扣费校准（上游改计费不改目录时不至于永远占住免费档）。模型级限流只避让该模型；多轮对话粘同一凭证，出错才轮换。 - **到期额度优先**：主窗口（默认 36h）先烧将过期额度；打平再比 7 天窗口。单位统一积分。 - **模型列表按凭证加载**：只列有可用凭证的渠道 → 无幽灵模型。 - **公共凭证池**：admin 维护、全员共享、加密入库（`APP_SECRET`）；设备码登录、多账号切换、额度探测、签到、token 预刷新。 - **三角色**：`admin` / `operator` / `viewer`，存 SQLite；一次性激活链接、首登强制改密、改角色 / 停用即时吊销会话；登录与写操作留审计。 - **成长中心**（仅 CodeBuddy）：领礼、派 Buddy、领任务奖、断登补登、连登兑换、开盲盒。不可逆动作 `GROWTH_IRREVERSIBLE_ACTIONS=false` 关停。 - **脱敏统计**：不存对话；明细 90 天、小时汇总永久；按人 / 渠道 / 模型 / 凭证可视化；成本按 OpenRouter 刊例价估算；速度分正文 / 总产出；明细走 SSE。 - **月度账单**（`operator` 起）：按月按人 / 按 API Key 汇总请求、token 与成本；CSV（按人）/ JSONL（逐条明细）导出并写审计。按 Key 明细受 90 天保留期限制。 - **工具调用健壮性**：`id` 缺失按 index 补并记忆；DeepSeek DSML 泄漏回读成结构化调用并改写 `finish_reason`；非流式坏 `arguments` fail-closed（400，不冷却凭证）。 - **渠道 ToS 风险登记**：导入凭证时展示 green / gray / red 与理由（运营判断），审计留等级；只提示不阻断调度。 - **出口 IP 粘性**（可选）：`CREDENTIAL_PROXY_POOL` 非空时一号一出口（sha256 稳定分配，重启不漂移）；推理、探活、签到、预刷新、成长、管理台单条动作都走同一出口。 - **上游状态聚合**：并排官方状态页，区分「上游故障」与「本服务凭证 / 额度问题」。只解释、不调度；只存内存。 - **侧栏数据提醒**：待办角标（需重登 / 耗尽、未恢复告警、任务失败、异常上游、待激活账号、将到期 Key、目录陈旧），按角色裁剪。[口径](#侧栏数据提醒导航角标) - **管理台加固**：登录限流、CSRF、请求体上限、Host 白名单。 - **窄屏表格转卡片**：<768px 一行 = 一卡；列名收成可点排序片。DOM 不变，读屏语义一致。 协议层（私有信封、签名、门禁伪装）见 [`TECHNICAL.md`](TECHNICAL.md)。 ## 界面预览 管理台（截图取自本地实例，账号 / IP 已脱敏）： | 凭证管理：池概况与渠道分组 | 用量统计：请求 / token / 成本 | |---|---| | ![凭证管理](assets/screenshots/credentials.webp) | ![用量统计](assets/screenshots/stats.webp) | | **Playground：模型 × 渠道与倍率** | **模型列表

The Windows desktop app is built from [`office-agent-desktop/`](office-agent-desktop/). ## Repository | Path | | |---|---| | `office-agent/` | The Python backend, the React frontend and the tests | | `office-agent-desktop/` | The Electron desktop shell | | `docs/` | Engineering docs: the plan, decisions, the log of what shipped | | `site/` | The project website (GitHub Pages) | ## Contributing Developers and AI coding sessions: start with [`CLAUDE.md`](CLAUDE.md) (a map of the code and what to read first) and [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md). Before every change run `cd office-agent && bash scripts/check.sh`. Security issues: see [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md). # go-magic **Magic Agent** -- A high-performance, ultra-lightweight AI Agent framework written in Go. [![Go Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Go-1.26%2B-00ADD8)](https://go.dev) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-v0.5.9-green)](https://github.com/magicwubiao/go-magic/releases) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) ## Overview go-magic is a full-featured AI Agent framework that combines a powerful Go backend with a modern Vue 3/TypeScript web dashboard. github.text_excerpt: # Hive **Website & docs: [hivecli.sh](https://hivecli.sh)** — quickstart, concepts, the full command reference, and an [`llms.txt`](https://hivecli.sh/llms.txt) for agents. Community: [join the Hive Discord](https://discord.gg/Qg5E7rMt) for questions, feedback, and release discussions. Hive is a durable, local-first workflow engine for AI agents. It orchestrates Claude, Codex, Grok, Pi, opt-in OpenCode, and Muse to run multi-step work as a *folder-as-agent pipeline*. Its flagship **`coding`** workflow turns a rough software idea into a merge-ready pull request: you sketch an idea in a few sentences, open the `hive tui` dashboard or native local web UI, and watch the work move forward — brainstorm pins down what you actually want, plan fixes the approach, execute writes the code, review hardens it, and finalize ships the PR. You can step in at any stage with a normal editor — every artefact is a markdown file in a stage folder, inspectable and editable by you or by another agent. Software delivery is the flagship proof, not the product boundary: Hive also ships `content` and `bench` workflows, installs reviewed Honeycombs, and runs the ones you author yourself for writing, research, triage, audits, and operations (see [Custom Workflows](#custom-workflows)). The mental model is folders. Every task is a directory; the folder's location is the task state. Moving a task from `2-brainstorm/` to `3-plan/` is the approval gesture, and every stage writes a durable artefact the next stage can trust. That practice — making each step's output strong enough for the next one to run autonomously — is called *compound engineering*. It's how Hive carries work from rough idea to merged PR while letting humans drop in on their own terms instead of a chat thread's.
